limits.species: Neutral molecular H2 only; not atomic H, an ion or elemental composition averaged over species. One mole of H2 contains two moles of H atoms.
limits.spin_population: UNSPECIFIED-IN-RETAINED-SHOMATE-TABLE. Other-name aliases o-Hydrogen and p-Hydrogen do not assign the three fits to normal, para, ortho or equilibrium H2 and do not establish any numeric spin fraction.
limits.pressure: The page labels separate gas entropy reference data at 1 bar. The Shomate equations carry standard-state superscripts and no pressure input; an applied sample pressure or arbitrary-pressure EOS is not supplied.
limits.phase: Only GAS Shomate fits are supplied, 298–6000 K. Do not extrapolate to the 20.271 K equilibrium-H2 boiling point, cryogenic liquid/solid, phase changes or spin conversion.
limits.equilibrium: No temperature-dependent dissociation, ionisation or equilibrium species/spin populations are calculated.
limits.reference_state: H equation reports H(T)-H(298.15 K) in kJ/mol H2; entropy and Cp use J/mol H2/K. Fit minimum 298 K is not a new standard reference.
limits.uncertainty: The coefficients provide no coefficient uncertainties or covariance; quantity uncertainty remains UNKNOWN. Publisher rounding and numerical derivative residuals are software/source-format checks, not physical uncertainty.
limits.ownership: Existing SRC-000007 atomic H, SRC-000010 molecular identity/spectroscopy, SRC-000011 equilibrium-H2 phase reference and SRC-000012 distinct para/normal/ortho EOS retain separate identities and scope. No existing owners edited.
